map.ABV 经验公式准吗？: Is the ABV empirical formula accurate?
map.ABV=(OG−FG)×131.25 为常用近似，误差约±0.3% vol，精确: ABV = (OG - FG) x 131.25 is the common approximation, with error about +/-0.3% vol; for exact values rely on an alcoholmeter or distillation measurement.
map.OG = 1 + (总糖分 × 效率 / 水量) × 0.038；FG = 1: OG = 1 + (total sugar x efficiency / water volume) x 0.038; FG = 1 - (OG - 1) x attenuation; ABV = (OG - FG) x 131.25. ...
map.OG 为发酵前原麦汁比重，FG 为发酵后最终比重；两者差值反映糖转化为酒精的程度: OG is the original gravity before fermentation and FG the final gravity after it; the difference reflects how much sugar turned into alcohol.
